specifications.description: Concrete placement pressure model and load cases
Closed simple orthogonal polygon no unsupported holes
Each external face interval covered exactly once
Pair boundaries do not create physical Waler joints
Tie crossing/rebar clash and forbidden zones
Plywood shear including rolling where applicable
Waler reactions from actual discrete loads
Paired rail load distribution and contact
Tie assembly completeness and matching basis
Vertical load cases including extra dead/live
Slab-beam shared area owner and no double count
Bracing X/Y and necessary plan restraint
All required checks populated, none missing
Independent engineering review and authorized approval

Pair boundaries do not create physical Waler joints
Tie crossing/rebar clash and forbidden zones
Plywood shear including rolling where applicable
Waler reactions from actual discrete loads
Paired rail load distribution and contact
Tie assembly completeness and matching basis
Vertical load cases including extra dead/live
Slab-beam shared area owner and no double count
Bracing X/Y and necessary plan restraint
All required checks populated, none missing
Independent engineering review and authorized approval

Closed simple orthogonal polygon no unsupported holes
Each external face interval covered exactly once
Pair boundaries do not create physical Waler joints
Tie crossing/rebar clash and forbidden zones

Waler reactions from actual discrete loads
Paired rail load distribution and contact
Tie assembly completeness and matching basis
Vertical load cases including extra dead/live
Slab-beam shared area owner and no double count
Bracing X/Y and necessary plan restraint
All required checks populated, none missing
Independent engineering review and authorized approval

specifications.description: Concrete placement pressure model and load cases
Closed simple orthogonal polygon no unsupported holes
Each external face interval covered exactly once
Pair boundaries do not create physical Waler joints
Tie crossing/rebar clash and forbidden zones
Plywood shear including rolling where applicable
Waler reactions from actual discrete loads
Paired rail load distribution and contact
Tie assembly completeness and matching basis
Vertical load cases including extra dead/live
Slab-beam shared area owner and no double count
Bracing X/Y and necessary plan restraint
All required checks populated, none missing
Independent engineering review and authorized approval
